definitions.explanation: A long flexible rod used for fishing, typically with a line, reel, and hook attached.

examples.japanese: {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}を{持|も}って{川|かわ}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the river with my fishing rod.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}から{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}をもらった。
examples.english: I got a fishing rod from my father.

examples.japanese: {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}が{大|おお}きくしなった。
{初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}けの{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose a fishing rod for beginners.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{釣|つ}り (fishing) + {竿|さお} (pole/rod) → {竿|ざお} (rendaku)

ALTERNATIVE TERM:
{釣|つ}り{ざお} is also written as {釣竿|つりざお}.

TYPES:
- {延|の}べ{竿|ざお}: fixed-length rod (no reel)
- リール{竿|ざお}: rod with reel
- {投|な}げ{竿|ざお}: casting rod
- {磯竿|いそざお}: rock fishing rod
- ルアーロッド: lure fishing rod

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}を{振|ふ}る: cast the rod
- {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}をしまう: put away the fishing rod
- {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}が{折|お}れる: the rod breaks

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- リール: reel
- {糸|いと} / ライン: fishing line
- {針|はり}: hook
- {餌|えさ}: bait
- ルアー: lure

COUNTER: {本|ほん}
